findings.claim: OwnerEnded uses identity.AliveRef, which keeps a zombie Alive, so an exited but unreaped owner whose slot an inheriting process still holds is reported as not ended.
findings.evidence: host_admission_read.go:98 calls identity.AliveRef; identity.go:205-209 documents LiveRef for lease/lock/lane holders and AliveRef keeping zombies Alive; internal/landing/plain/prove.go:330 uses LiveRef for the lane prover.
findings.change: Use identity.LiveRef and add a T8 row whose prober returns Alive with Zombie true, expecting OwnerEnded.
findings.relation: identity.LiveRef is the reader for whether a recorded process still holds a lease (internal/identity/identity.go:205-209)

findings.claim: HostAdmission is exported but its element types hostAdmissionHeld and hostAdmissionWaiting are not, so U2b's steward and cmd tests cannot build holder or waiter fixtures or helpers by type.
findings.evidence: host_admission_read.go:15-31; brief section 4 table: U2b leaves internal/proofrun untouched; U2b item 6 words for (ended) and argv holders need fabricated holders to test outside the real reader.
findings.relation: a cross-package view's element types are nameable by the consumer unit that may not touch this package (U2b leaves internal/proofrun untouched)

findings.claim: A marker removed between os.Open and validateHostLockFile, or a just-created marker whose creator has not yet written its record, is counted Unreadable instead of being skipped.
findings.evidence: host_admission_read.go:57-83 skips IsNotExist only on the open; readHostLeaseRecord and validateHostLockFile return the Lstat ENOENT unwrapped and it is counted; nestedUnderLeaseHolder skips the same states (host_resources.go:806-812).
findings.change: Treat os.IsNotExist(readErr) after validation as a skip.
findings.relation: a marker that vanishes is not held (heldByAnother, host_resources.go:752-756)

findings.claim: No test pins that a heavy lease acquired without the lane priority records no priority; a mutant that marks every heavy lease lane, or records run, survives.
findings.evidence: T8 acquires only with WithLaneCheckPriority; grep of internal/proofrun/*_test.go finds no other read of .Priority or "priority".
findings.change: Add a row that acquires heavy without WithLaneCheckPriority and asserts Priority is empty.
findings.relation: a test kills the mutations its seam can show (brief section 7)

findings.claim: The absent row exercises only the configured route of hostAdmissionPathFrom, and ReadHostAdmission is asserted only to return no error, so a mutant wiring it to the creating hostAdmissionDirectory survives.
findings.evidence: host_admission_read_test.go:43-46 and the absent directory subtest use admissionReadPath(directory), the configured route; the env-selected route needs t.Setenv (serial) and U2a adds no serial test.
findings.change: None required in U2a; U2b's T7 reads through the production reader in a selected namespace.
findings.relation: a test kills the mutations its seam can show (brief section 7)

#
# Every default is compiled into the engine (internal/config/defaults.go),
# once: `metasystem settings keys` lists every key with a value and
# `metasystem settings show KEY` prints KEY=value (source), where the source
# is default, conf, conf-local or env. Write a line here only to change a
# default for everyone who uses this repository; a value that must not ship
# (a machine's port, a seat's own roster, a secret) goes in the uncommitted
# metasystem.conf.local beside this file, which wins over this file and
# loses to the environment (METASYSTEM_<KEY>) and to an explicit flag.

# This repository is the metasystem template itself: the one template-mode
# signal. Adoption never ships this line.
metasystem.template=true

# One goal per batch until the measured trigger in plans/designs/landing-takes-an-hour-pipeline.md.

# The critique round cap is a far-away backstop here: loops end on materiality
# and divergence, never on the count (Wido 2026-10-02). Adopters keep the
# compiled default of five.
metasystem.budget.review-round-max=30
# Tier boxes carry the same far-away round cap, so new goals do not need an
# exception for it.
metasystem.budget.tier-2=4h/6/720m/1/20
metasystem.budget.tier-3=8h/10/1200m/1/20

# The commented lines below document keys a project may set: some have a
# compiled default, the rest are unset until someone names them.

# A machine sets its own interface port in the .local file.
# ui.listen=127.0.0.1:7878
# The name the interface gives this workspace; empty names the template itself
# when self-hosted, and the checkout otherwise.
# ui.subject=
# How long a browser session a human signed into with the seat's one-time code
# lasts, in whole hours. Twelve is the default.
# ui.session.hours=12
# The handle the interface signs in as when no enrolled terminal started it.
# Unset, the sign-in sheet asks once and the server keeps the answer. The code
# itself is channel.human.totp-secret, which lives in the .local file only.
# ui.human=
# The Project Partner: which agent answers in the drawer. claude, codex or
# devin, and unset — the default — is a seat with no Partner at all. Naming one
# also closes the boot proof's path to the act routes: a seat that runs an
# agent requires a signed-in human for every act, because a local process can
# send a cookie-less request and an agent request must never become a human
# act. The Partner reads this checkout and nothing else: it has no shell, no
# network, no MCP server, and no approval inherited from this seat's own
# settings.
# ui.partner.runtime=
# The model the Partner's session runs. Unset is the runtime's own default.
# A model the runtime cannot select refuses the turn with the runtime's words.
# ui.partner.model=
# How to start one runtime's ACP server, as a command line. Unset is the
# runtime's published entry point on PATH: claude-agent-acp from
# @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp, codex-acp from
# @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp, and `devin acp` from the Devin CLI.
# ui.partner.command.claude=
# ui.partner.command.codex=
# ui.partner.command.devin=
# What the interface's private store outside every checkout is kept to. It
# holds the Partner's transcripts, its wire journal and the human's notepad,
# under the account's registry home. These are retention targets rather than
# disk ceilings — the last two hundred messages of a conversation are always
# kept, and a day passes between sweeps — and zero disables that bound. No
# directory is ever removed, nothing in a checkout is touched, and no record of
# the project is: the records are the memory that survives.
# How many megabytes the Partner's wire journal may reach before its own writer
# rotates it, keeping one previous.
# ui.store.wire-mb=8
# How many megabytes one human's transcript may reach, and how old its oldest
# message may be, before its oldest messages are trimmed.
# ui.store.conversation-mb=2
# ui.store.conversation-days=90
# Total adapter-worker allowance for one test attempt. When absent, the engine
# captures GOMAXPROCS once and divides it by the resolved top-level proof
# admission maximum (treating unlimited admission as one), with a floor of one.
# Any explicit value must be positive; there is no arbitrary machine-size cap
# at top level. A positive inherited METASYSTEM_TEST_WORKERS is always a nested
# cooperative ceiling; a malformed or non-positive inherited value is refused.
# testing.workers=4

# seat.presence-namespace pins presence to one ref namespace
# (refs/metasystem/presence or refs/heads/presence). Left unset, the
# publisher climbs the ladder by itself and remembers the rung that worked.

# Spend accounting is alert-only. Uncomment ceilings to override the compiled
# defaults; prices use spend.price.<runtime>.<canonical-model>.<class> and are
# deliberately absent until Wido records the model rates.
# spend.mode=alert
# spend.currency=USD
# spend.ceiling.day.tokens=250000000
# spend.ceiling.day.money=750
# spend.ceiling.goal.tokens=125000000
# spend.ceiling.goal.money=300

# Claude defaults to its project memory directory. Other runtimes name an
# absolute directory before they record a handoff.
# context.handoff.note-directory.codex=/absolute/path/to/runtime-memory

# Host-wide cap on concurrent top-level proof attempts: unset means one on this host.
# An explicit override changes the cap; 0 disables it.
# proof.admission.top-level-max=1

# The durable evidence root defaults to ~/metasystem-evidence/<checkout name>;
